passages.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David, the servant of the LORD.
passages.sermon: David wrote this psalm.\r\nDavid served the LORD.\r\nThe choirmaster received this psalm.

passages.text: An oracle is in my heart regarding the transgression of the wicked man: There is no fear of God before his eyes.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
David was a servant of the LORD.
David spoke to the choirmaster.
David received a message in his heart.
This message was about the sin of a wicked man.
The wicked man does not fear God.
The wicked man does not see God before his eyes.
passages.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֬חַ׀ לְעֶֽבֶד־ יְהוָ֬ה לְדָוִֽד׃ נְאֻֽם־ פֶּ֣שַׁע לָ֭רָשָׁע בְּקֶ֣רֶב לִבִּ֑י אֵֽין־ פַּ֥חַד אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים לְנֶ֣גֶד עֵינָֽיו׃

passages.text: For his eyes are too full of conceit to detect or hate his own sin.
passages.sermon:
The wicked man is proud.
He looks at himself with conceit.
He cannot see his own sin.
He does not hate his own sin.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ הֶחֱלִ֣יק אֵלָ֣יו בְּעֵינָ֑יו לִמְצֹ֖א עֲוֺנ֣וֹ לִשְׂנֹֽא׃

passages.text: The words of his mouth are wicked and deceitful; he has ceased to be wise and well-doing.
passages.sermon:
The wicked man speaks with his mouth.
His words are wicked.
His words are deceitful.
He no longer acts with wisdom.
He no longer does what is good.
passages.original: דִּבְרֵי־ פִ֭יו אָ֣וֶן וּמִרְמָ֑ה חָדַ֖ל לְהַשְׂכִּ֣יל לְהֵיטִֽיב׃

passages.text: Even on his bed he plots wickedness; he sets himself on a path that is not good; he fails to reject evil.
passages.sermon:
A wicked person lies on his bed.
He thinks about doing evil.
He chooses a path that is not good.
He does not reject evil.
He accepts what is wrong.
passages.original: אָ֤וֶן׀ יַחְשֹׁ֗ב עַֽל־ מִשְׁכָּ֫ב֥וֹ יִ֭תְיַצֵּב עַל־ דֶּ֣רֶךְ לֹא־ ט֑וֹב רָ֝֗ע לֹ֣א יִמְאָֽס׃

passages.text: Your loving devotion, O LORD, reaches to the heavens, Your faithfulness to the clouds.
passages.sermon:
The LORD shows loving devotion.
His loving devotion reaches to the heavens.
The LORD is faithful.
His faithfulness reaches to the clouds.
passages.original: יְ֭הוָה בְּהַשָּׁמַ֣יִם חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ אֱ֝מֽוּנָתְךָ֗ עַד־ שְׁחָקִֽים׃

passages.text: Your righteousness is like the highest mountains; Your judgments are like the deepest sea. O LORD, You preserve man and beast.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is righteous.
His righteousness stands tall like the highest mountains.
His judgments are deep like the deepest sea.
The LORD preserves people.
The LORD preserves animals.
passages.original: צִדְקָֽתְךָ֨׀ כְּֽהַרְרֵי־ אֵ֗ל מִ֭שְׁפָּטֶךָ תְּה֣וֹם רַבָּ֑ה אָ֤דָֽם־ וּבְהֵמָ֖ה תוֹשִׁ֣יעַ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: How precious is Your loving devotion, O God, that the children of men take refuge in the shadow of Your wings!
passages.sermon:
God shows loving devotion.
God’s loving devotion is very precious.
God’s loving devotion is valuable.
People are the children of men.
People find safety in God.
People take refuge under God’s protection.
God’s protection is like the shadow of His wings.
passages.original: מַה־ יָּקָ֥ר חַסְדְּךָ֗ אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים וּבְנֵ֥י אָדָ֑ם בְּצֵ֥ל כְּ֝נָפֶ֗יךָ יֶחֱסָיֽוּן׃

passages.text: They feast on the abundance of Your house, and You give them drink from Your river of delights.
passages.sermon:
God provides for His people.
God’s house is full of good things.
God’s people eat and are satisfied in His house.
God gives His people water to drink.
God’s river is full of delights.
God lets His people drink from this river.
passages.original: יִ֭רְוְיֻן מִדֶּ֣שֶׁן בֵּיתֶ֑ךָ וְנַ֖חַל עֲדָנֶ֣יךָ תַשְׁקֵֽם׃

passages.text: For with You is the fountain of life; in Your light we see light.
passages.sermon:
God is the source of life.
Life comes from God.
God gives light.
We see light because of God's light.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ עִ֭מְּךָ מְק֣וֹר חַיִּ֑ים בְּ֝אוֹרְךָ֗ נִרְאֶה־ אֽוֹר׃

passages.text: Extend Your loving devotion to those who know You, and Your righteousness to the upright in heart.
passages.sermon:
David speaks to God.
God shows loving devotion.
God gives loving devotion to people who know Him.
God is righteous.
God gives righteousness to people who are upright in heart.
passages.original: מְשֹׁ֣ךְ חַ֭סְדְּךָ לְיֹדְעֶ֑יךָ וְ֝צִדְקָֽתְךָ֗ לְיִשְׁרֵי־ לֵֽב׃

passages.text: Let not the foot of the proud come against me, nor the hand of the wicked drive me away.
passages.sermon:
David speaks to God.
David asks God for protection.
David says, “Do not let the proud attack me.”
David says, “Do not let the wicked force me away.”
passages.original: אַל־ תְּ֭בוֹאֵנִי רֶ֣גֶל גַּאֲוָ֑ה וְיַד־ רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים אַל־ תְּנִדֵֽנִי׃

passages.text: There the evildoers lie fallen, thrown down and unable to rise.
passages.sermon:
Evildoers act with wickedness.
They fall there.
They are thrown down.
They cannot rise.
passages.original: שָׁ֣ם נָ֭פְלוּ פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָ֑וֶן דֹּ֝ח֗וּ וְלֹא־ יָ֥כְלוּ קֽוּם׃
